correctness.rationale: Yamaguchi's Theorem 2.5 supplies a surjection of étale fundamental groups with topologically perfect kernel. For a finite locally constant solvable group sheaf from the ambient scheme, that kernel acts trivially on the fiber. A nonabelian cocycle restricts to a homomorphism from the perfect kernel into the solvable fiber; its image is both perfect and solvable and is therefore trivial. The cocycle and its coboundary relation descend uniquely to the quotient.

value.rationale: The statement upgrades an extension theorem for solvable coverings to a twisted nonabelian H^1 excision principle. It remains meaningful when the monodromy image in the automorphism group of the solvable fiber is nonsolvable, so it is not just a restatement of maximal-prosolvable quotient invariance. This gives a reusable criterion for extending finite solvable torsors with ambient local monodromy across horizontal boundary divisors.
